thread:
Alex H: Heads-up — found a cluster of 404s in the runtime guide TOC after yesterday's deploy. Can folks own quick triage?

Jordan C: Which pages? got a list?

Alex H: Top ones: /runtime/quickstart, /runtime/advanced-batching, and a couple of /ja pages. I dumped a grep of 404s into a gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcdef123456

Maria S: I'll take runtime/quickstart and the /ja runtime quickstart. @Kevin L can you verify redirects? :eyes:

Kevin L: Happy to. Quick check: are these missing because of frontmatter slug changes or CDN/image 403s? Any logs?

Alex H: Looks like a frontmatter slug mismatch for quickstart (slug: runtime-qs -> runtime-quickstart). Also one orphan anchor in advanced-batching. Suggested sed to fix frontmatter:

```bash
rg -l "slug: runtime-qs" docs | xargs sed -i "s/slug: runtime-qs/slug: runtime-quickstart/"
```

Maria S: Thanks — will open a tiny PR. Do we need to run the docs build preview? I can attach preview link.

Jordan C: Please add a changelog bullet and ping #eng if preview shows permalink changes.

docs-bot: Reminder: schedule a content rebuild after PR merges to clear stale CDN. :construction:

Kevin L: For the advanced-batching anchor, I'll either add an explicit anchor above the heading or update the link to `#kv-cache`. PR incoming in ~10m.

Maria S: PRs opened: #4567 runtime-qs-slug-fix, #4568 advanced-batching-anchor. Preview URLs attached in PR descriptions.

Alex H: Awesome. If either of you need redirect entries, ping me and I can add them to redirect_map.yml. Let's aim to merge both today. Thanks! :rocket:

Jordan C: Noted — I'll watch the canary after merges.
